name: Dauntless 1.14.7
blurb: The last build before Awakening: the full 2023 Ramsgate, every weapon line as it was, and the Hunting Grounds as most players remember them.
warning: Experimental. 1.14.7 is much less complete than 1.6.2: expect missing features, odd behaviour and the occasional crash. Play 1.6.2 for the full experience.
works: Slayer copy no longer brings 1.6.2's Middleman token over: it made 1.14.7 refuse your inventory and send you back to the menu. Saves that already have it are repaired when you press Play
Sign in offline, Ramsgate, NPCs and quests (quest progress is saved)
Modded mode (test): UE4SS mods and a Boss Health Bar (behemoth and part health) from the launcher's Mods page: Get UE4SS, then Modded mode On
Quest and dialogue text (fix by KombatKing)
Hunt quests (kills on the right island count)
Potions, lanterns, Omnicells and weapon specials (equipment fix by KombatKing, test build)
Training grounds, sprint, attacking
Hunts (tested: the first Embermane hunt)
Online with friends: the launcher's Friends page, Play online and Host Mode (and ONLINE - HOST / LAN - JOIN by hand)
Parties: invite a player in Ramsgate (Q on them); the party follows the leader into the training grounds and hunts (test)

KombatKing's All-in-One R1: Fountain gift and free supplies pack, Middleman slots and 7-minute fusion, Trials store, Hunt Pass seasons and a 400-tier Mega pass, bounties, power surge saving, War Hammer reload
Sparkforge reforge: weapon back to level 1, reforge badge, Aetherheart right away
Test (KombatKing): Game Rules up to 5x, one free All Dyes pack, Gauntlet access and extra Trials destinations (no Gauntlet rewards yet)

KombatKing's Oct 18 fixes (test): bigger Trials shop (72 items: mods, specials, Omnicells), potions and the Springtide egg no longer expire, loadout saving and switching fixed, old logs cleaned up, Free platinum game rule
Trials Quick Retry (Mods page, off by default): a spare copy of the trial warms up while you play, so Retry is instant on the host PC (about 4 GB of free RAM)

Intel Arc and other GPUs whose D3D11 driver crashes the game at start: put DXVK's dxgi.dll next to the game exe as dxgi_chain.dll (and its d3d11.dll beside it); the loader uses it instead of Windows' DXGI (issue #4)
Hunts that cannot start now say why (reserved UDP ports, a port in use, the server copy closed by an antivirus, timeout) in the game and under the launcher's Play button, instead of searching forever
Joiners can no longer land on the host's character (host guard), and the crash guard now covers the second crash site after a behemoth dies

Party and multiplayer fixes (test): the training grounds take 4 players, a player who left a hunt no longer keeps others stuck in Ramsgate (the airship loop), parties survive a server restart, party members can follow a running hunt after 15 minutes, a new hunt from the dojo takes the whole party, and the party goes back to Ramsgate with the leader
Hunts run at the FPS they had before Oct 18: the crash guard's per-object checks no longer call into Windows (CPU 90-100% on hunts fixed, Oct 21)
notWorking: New characters joining a friend get stuck loading the tutorial: do the tutorial in solo play first. Hunting together as a party is new and only lightly tested. Much else may not work yet.
